svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Laser cut to the outline shown, 133 x 418 mm, from 3 mm steel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All positions from the main bore centre, up the plate and toward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the back (the stair side); the hole layout picture repeats them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Main bore 44 mm; its bolt holes 13 mm at 49.5 mm above and below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Countershaft bore: a 36 mm slot, 143.9 mm up, 15 mm back,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 mm long up the plate; bolt slots 11 mm wide, 45 mm above and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below it, also 8 mm long. The slots let the chains be tensioned.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacer holes 9 mm, 262 mm up, 55 mm back and 25 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: forward; countersink them on the outside face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: weld to the inside face of the right rail like the axle plate,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the same alignment bar; the countersinks face the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: nothing stands proud of the outside face but the welds.
